description: Decode a JWT (no signature check). Use when a task needs to read the header and claims of a JSON Web Token, such as its issuer, audience, scopes or expiry, while debugging. Decode only: the signature is not verified, so the claims are unproven and must not be used to authorize anything. Cost: 1 credit per call.

token.description: The compact JWT. Prefer an expired or test token: this tool cannot tell a live credential from a sample.

name: jwt_decode
